notes: J2 prints its verdict on stderr (journeys/run.py:54) so the proof merges 2>&1; the results jsonl is printed for per-case PASS lines (journeys/lib/harness.py:248-270); a red scaffold is history: _captures/tests-j2/j2-red-real-app.txt:4 ('J2 RED: 7 steps, 36 checks, 7 failed, 28 not judged'), so 'red at scaffold' is not re-provable now and is not claimed. J2 now has 8 steps (J2.1-J2.8, journeys/J2.py:338-520), hence '\d+ steps'. Selftest: journeys/J2.py:594-618 (dry, no app). perf/search.py: budget SEARCH_FIRST_SCREEN_MS '100 on 1M messages' (docs/CONSTANTS.md:15), exit code rule lines 120-124, NOT JUDGED rules lines 84-114. Proof 3 needs $WHOOSH_BUNDLE (the runner's bundle) and a hidden launch; it cannot pass until (C). Theme (lane gap-themes): journeys/J2.py:342 calls `_theme.apply(s)` (journeys/lib/theme.py:20-24: `fixture theme <WHOOSH_THEME, default light>`, then the case `J2.1/theme-applied` reads uistate theme), TITLE says the theme (J2.py:90), MUTANTS row J2.py:534. Proof 4 runs the journey with WHOOSH_THEME=dark and prints, from journeys/lib/summary.py, the line 'THEME J2.1 theme-applied PASS got=dark'; the light pass is proof 0 (the default theme). Proof 5: `journeys/run.py --dry --themes light,dark J2` prints one line per theme ('[light] J2 ...', '[dark] J2 ...'; no app is launched, so the verdict word there is COULD-NOT-DRIVE and is not read). On a real run `--themes` writes each pass under <results folder>/<theme>/ and both passes drive one app (a fixture core cannot be reset): the lead launches once per theme, as proofs 0 and 4 do. A light run cannot show that the app applies a theme (a build that ignores the verb stays light): only the dark proof can. | lane fix-rest-app: piece (C) is built: `fixture seed-corpus <N>` (FixtureVerbs.swift, FixtureCore.seedCorpus in FixtureHistory.swift: exactly N generated mails over the fixture's accounts, `index/message_count` reads N), unit proof 6. Proof 3 is the first run of the cell on the real verb: N = 1,000,000 generated mails are held in the test copy's memory, and the socket's answer time for the verb at that size is unmeasured (the 300,000 of `fixture load full-history-30` answered in about 1.1 s plus 5.3 s before launch-r3); if the cell prints NOT JUDGED naming the seed, that is the measure to send back.
